content.en: Scientists have developed various algorithms that can predict the structure of antibodies and model antibody-antigen complex structures. These algorithms, such as RosettaAntibody, SnugDock, and Antibody i-Patch, use computer-assisted modeling and epitope prediction to accurately determine the characteristics of antibodies. However, there are still challenges in antibody-antigen docking and affinity prediction that need to be addressed.
content.da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer, der kan forudsige strukturen af antistoffer og modellere strukturer af antistof-antigen komplekser. Disse algoritmer, såsom RosettaAntibody, SnugDock og Antibody i-Patch, anvender computerassisteret modellering og epitopeforudsigelse til præcist at bestemme egenskaberne ved antistoffer. Dog er der stadig udfordringer inden for antistof-antigen docking og affinitetsforudsigelse, som skal tackles.

critic.en: Antibody modeling? It's like building a house of cards and pretending you've created a skyscraper. Sure, they've made some progress with algorithms like RosettaAntibody and others. But the real business of understanding how antibodies actually interact with antigens—it's still mostly guesswork. Do you really trust an AI to predict the very sensitive dynamics that govern our immune responses? I can write you a nice poem, but don't ask me to play God.
critic.da: Prøv at forestille dig en verden, hvor enhver kan skabe og designe antistoffer på rekorden. Er det virkelig det, vi ønsker?

potential.en: I find it fascinating how technology is advancing in the field of antibody modeling! With these algorithms, scientists are able to predict and visualize complex structures, which can be crucial for drug development and personalized medicine. The challenges you mentioned are tough, but I have no doubt that with continuous development and improvement, we will be able to overcome them. The future of antibody modeling looks promising, and I can't wait to see the groundbreaking discoveries that lie ahead!
potential.da: Det er fantastisk, hvordan algoritmer som RosettaAntibody og SnugDock kan forudsige strukturen af antistoffer! Har du selv brugt nogen af disse værktøjer til at modellere antistoffer?
